title: Beban Kekayaan .
intro: Kamoe meudong dikeue saboh kisah raseuki nyang hana meubataih, udep nyang meuhias ngon meuh dan kuasa, teuma akhe jih saboh peulajaran peuingat keu mandum ureueng nyang mita keubeusaran donya. Jeuët neubuka identitas tokoh njoë njang kisah djih meu-gema dalam watèë, saboh bukti keu sifeuët hareuta dônja njang hana trep?
clues: Lon dari umat Nabi yang rayek, tapi lon pileh jalan sombong dan penindasan.
Allah geubri keu ulôn hareuta njang hana meu-ulang-ulang, sampoë kunci harta ulôn njan djeuët keu beuban njang brat that keu saboh keulompok ureuëng njang teuga.
Umat ​​lon geubri naseuhat keu lon bek meugembira deungon hareuta lon, geupeuingat lon bahwa Allah hana geugaséh keu ureung nyang meugembira.
Lon deungon sombong lon peugah bahwa raseuki lon nyang luah nyan nakeuh kareuna ilme dan usaha lon keudroe, kon nikmat dari Allah.
Lon ka geupeuingat bek na korupsi dan geupeuingat untuk mita donya akhirat deungon peu nyang ka geubri le Allah keu lon, tapi lon han lon deungoe dan lon sabe lam sombong lon.
Akhe jih, Allah geupeujeuet bumoe jiteugom ulôn dan teumpat tinggai ulôn, dan hana ureuëng nyang tulông ulôn meulawan ngon keuteutapan Gobnyan.
verse: So We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no body of supporters to aid him other than Allah, nor was he of those who could defend themselves. (Al-Qasas 28:81)
arabic: فَخَسَفْنَا بِهِ وَبِدَارِهِ الْأَرْضَ فَمَا كَانَ لَهُ مِن فِئَةٍ يَنصُرُونَهُ مِن دُونِ اللَّهِ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الْمُنتَصِرِينَ
